svg.desc: nr-workbench: how a neutron reflectometry analysis flows from an empty folder to a published, reproducible result, and what the user, nrw, the project files and the assistants each do at every stage.
svg.text: nr-workbench · from an empty folder to a published, reproducible result
A project workbench for neutron reflectometry at SNS REF_L. Read it left to right for the analysis, top to bottom for who does what.
1 Set up a project
2 Bring the data in
3 Write the model
4 Fit it
5 Look, decide, share
You
what you do
Run nrw init in an empty folder,
or on top of a beamtime folder you
already have. nrw doctor checks the
install. Open the folder in VS Code.
Measuring now? On the Experiment page,
pick runs as they land, assign them to a
sample with a condition, and apply.
Otherwise copy reduced files in, or
nrw import an older beamtime folder.
Describe the sample in sample.md.

text.tspan: Say what the sample is made of.

svg.text: Write the stack by hand, or let AuRE or
your coding assistant propose it from
your notes. Review every layer.

text.tspan: Everything else, runs, angles, states and
time series, is read from the files.

svg.text: (--method dream for uncertainties).
Try variants. nrw ls lists every
attempt with what changed; nrw diff
says whether chi-squared moved because
of the model, the data or the optimizer.
Open nrw serve: the sample landscape,
each fit with SLD profiles and residuals.
Star, Finalize or Discard a fit.
Write down why with nrw note.
Ask nrw whence where any figure
came from, even one emailed out.
nrw
commands and web pages
Writes one layout for every sample, 19
reflectometry skills, and the instructions
and limits for each assistant.

text.tspan: Safe to re-run: it never overwrites a

svg.text: nrw serve watches the data folder and
copies only runs that finished arriving.
nrw data check and nrw data overlap
find normalisation errors before you
model them. nrw tnr assess says if a
time-resolved run changed, and how.
nrw model new scaffolds a spec from the
data. nrw model validate and
preview --build catch mistakes in a
second. nrw model generate writes
a standalone refl1d script plus a
plain-English account of what it assumes.
Runs refl1d and bumps on all cores.
Records the frozen script, every input
hash, package versions and git state.
A result whose data changed is marked
STALE everywhere. nrw assess flags
parameters stuck on a bound. nrw check
guards it all, in CI too.
nrw promote --as final names the
sample's answer, with your reason.
nrw pack zips a fit with its data and a
verify.py. nrw isaac push publishes
the final fit. nrw tiled push shares
the catalog and fits with your team.
Your project
plain files, in git

text.tspan: The spec ties angle segments, steady states
and time slices together without hand-
Figures the fit writes carry its id, so
A collaborator needs only refl1d, bumps
and numpy to reproduce the result.

svg.text: Assistants,
engines, services
what nrw drives for you
Claude Code, Copilot or OpenCode opened
in the folder already know REF_L: the
skills, the layout and the nrw commands.

text.tspan: No language-model key is needed for
anything on this diagram except where
AuRE or an endpoint is named.

svg.text: tiled.ornl.gov: nrw tiled pull brings a
colleague's catalog, data and fits into
a fresh project.

text.tspan: The reduction writes runs to the data
folder; nrw never touches raw NeXus.

svg.text: AuRE proposes a layer stack from your
description and iterates it against the
data (nrw aure new / run / import).
Your coding assistant gets the same job
from nrw model new --print-prompt;
--from-notes asks an LLM endpoint.
refl1d + bumps do the fitting.
nrw agent watch hands each settled
measurement to Claude Code or OpenCode,
held by limits it cannot talk past. It
fits only what your notes ask for.
ISAAC Portal receives the final fit as
linked records, one per condition, after
the portal validates them and you confirm.
A collaborator runs verify.py and
learns in one line whether their refl1d
gives your answer.
What holds throughout
Nothing you edited is overwritten.
nrw init and the Experiment page add; they never replace
your files.
Every result is traceable.
Script, data hashes, environment and reason, kept with
the fit, queried with nrw whence.
Every result is reproducible.
A bundle runs with only refl1d, and verify.py says
whether it gives the recorded number.
Assistants help; you decide.
Proposed stacks are labelled and checked; promoting a
fit is never automated.
